title: Against-Advocate Brief Output (engage-lexicon)
description: Schema for the structured report returned by the against-advocate subagent in engage-lexicon. Parallels for-brief-schema.json plus targetedCitationIndex, authorityHierarchyConflict, and the citationOverlap/authorityHierarchyOverlap tags. Enforces the dual-axis diversity contract (#202 AC5): URL non-overlap AND at least one unique controlling-authority tuple.

jurisdiction.description: The declared jurisdiction. Propagated from the jurisdiction-declared gate.

corePosition.description: One-to-two-sentence best-supported case AGAINST the claim, framed within {jurisdiction}.

citations.description: Ordered list of citations. Primary agent enforces zero URL overlap with the for-advocate's citations AND at least one unique controlling-authority tuple (jurisdiction, authorityType, primaryIdentifier) after both reports return.

targetedCitationIndex.description: 0-based index into the for-advocate's citations[] that this against-case most directly rebuts, OR null when the against-case attacks the claim generally rather than any single for-citation.

authorityHierarchyConflict.description: Optional. Names the specific authority-hierarchy point of conflict — the controlling authority the for-advocate cited that the against-advocate is countering with a higher-or-equal-rank controlling authority. Null when the against-case relies on persuasive authority or attacks on a different basis.

forCitationIndex.description: Index into the for-advocate's citations[] of the controlling-authority citation being countered.

againstCitationIndex.description: Index into THIS against-brief's citations[] of the countering controlling-authority citation.

conflictType.description: Nature of the authority-hierarchy conflict. 'higher-authority' = the against-citation outranks the for-citation in the hierarchy under {jurisdiction}. 'same-authority-different-holding' = different opinion within the same case or different paragraph within the same statute. 'later-amendment' = statutory amendment supersedes the for-advocate's relied-upon version. 'withdrawn-or-superseded' = agency guidance has been withdrawn or case has been overruled. 'out-of-jurisdiction-controlling-elsewhere' = the for-advocate's authority is binding in some forum but not in {jurisdiction}. 'split-of-authority' = circuits/courts are split.

citationOverlap.description: Primary-agent-assigned tag after URL-overlap check. 'none' = no overlap initially. 'resolved' = overlap found, one re-dispatch cleared it. 'unresolved' = overlap persisted after one re-dispatch.

authorityHierarchyOverlap.description: Primary-agent-assigned tag after authority-hierarchy diversity check. 'none' = at least one unique controlling-authority tuple initially. 'resolved' = overlap found, one re-dispatch cleared it. 'unresolved' = all controlling-authority tuples remained shared after one re-dispatch.

degradationEvidence.description: Set to 'unverified' when webResearch.performed=false with zero attemptedCalls[] after a re-dispatch.
